verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.ebanx.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a dedicated 'Instructions for LLM Agents' section. The file also includes substantive integration details, such as capture flow and EBANX.js usage. EBANX additionally publishes Agent Skills for AI coding assistants and an ebanx-integration-prompt.txt for generating runnable sandbox code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents pointed at these docs produce working integrations.
